questions.question: How does David begin Psalm 145?
options: 'Have mercy on me, O God, for I have sinned'
'I will extol you, my God and King'
'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'
'How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever?'
questions.answer: 'I will extol you, my God and King'

questions.question: How does the psalm describe the LORD's character?
options: Holy and unknowable, veiled deep in cloud and wrapped about in fire
Gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love
Mighty and dreadful, swift to judge and altogether terrible in wrath
Distant and hidden away, silent in heaven and very far from all men
questions.answer: Gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love
